_comment: Counts and dates are from the frozen 22 Aug 2026 corpus (14,733 request records; variant_dates compiled from results/run_*.json) and the campaign retirement record. 'added' is the first campaign measurement day (campaign start 2026-06-25); 'retired' is an API retirement date, null if the model was still live at compile date. effort_settings lists efforts with at least one successful sample. Edit by hand only with a corresponding note.

models.notes: Added 2026-07-23 as candidate R=1 non-reasoning baseline; later requests rejected with 400 'supported API model names are deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash'.
